text: @wenaixi/cfbridge 是 DSH Web 的 Cloudflare 桥接插件，通过 Bundle 接入 docs、search、execute MCP 工具和 14 个按需技能。用户可切换专属或全局模式，在设置面板搜索、启停技能并控制 MCP。适合查询 Cloudflare 文档、API 和辅助 Workers 开发；使用 MCP 需配置 CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN。

@wenaixi/cfbridge connects Cloudflare to DSH Web through docs, search, and execute MCP tools plus 14 on-demand skills. Its settings panel switches modes, searches and toggles skills, and controls MCP. Use it to consult Cloudflare docs and APIs. Cloudflare MCP requires CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN.

@wenaixi/cfbridge 的功能「按需提供 Cloudflare 技能」：DSH 的 SkillProvider 扫描技能目录并列出有效元数据；需要时再读取单个技能正文，用户也可关闭指定技能。
@wenaixi/cfbridge 的功能「接入 Cloudflare Code Mode MCP」：Bundle 配置 Cloudflare MCP 服务，接入 docs、search 和 execute 工具，并可通过设置关闭工具。
@wenaixi/cfbridge 的功能「切换 Cloudflare 运行模式」：设置面板可在 Cloudflare 专属 preset 与 global 模式间切换，插件据此安装预设和工具限制。
@wenaixi/cfbridge 的功能「管理技能和 MCP 设置」：Web 插件设置面板提供技能搜索、逐项启停、全部启用或停用，以及 MCP 总开关。
@wenaixi/cfbridge sends MCP requests to mcp.cloudflare.com and requires CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN (cordis.patch.yml:19-23).

@wenaixi/cfbridge README · cfbridge：A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) global bundle bridging Cloudflare's official Code Mode MCP (`docs` / `search` / `execute`) and 14 on-demand agent skills into all sessions. Mounting it to the `web` profile enables Cloudflare MCP tools across all conversations, paired with local project Wrangler CLI passthrough. Built with TypeScript, published as `lib/cfbridge.js`, distributed natively via `dsh.bundle`.

---

@wenaixi/cfbridge README · Install：**Prerequisites**: A runnable DSH installation (`dsh --profile web`); Node and pnpm engines listed in the badges above; a Cloudflare API token — recommended: Account token (`cfat_` with `Account Resources: Read`) or Zone token (`cfut_` for DNS operations).

@wenaixi/cfbridge README · Step 1: Provide API Token：Add your token to your private environment file (git-ignored, never commit real credentials):

```dotenv

@wenaixi/cfbridge README · %USERPROFILE%\.dsh\.env：CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN=your_token_here
```

@wenaixi/cfbridge README · Step 2: Install Bundle：Choose one of the installation methods below:

```powershell
@wenaixi/cfbridge README · Method A - npm (Recommended)：dsh plugin --profile web add @wenaixi/cfbridge
@wenaixi/cfbridge README · Method B - GitHub direct install：dsh plugin --profile web add github:Wenaixi/dsh-cfbridge

@wenaixi/cfbridge README · Method C - Local clone & build：git clone https://github.com/Wenaixi/dsh-cfbridge.git; cd dsh-cfbridge
npm install
npm run install:bundle            # Installs to web profile by default; use -- --profile <name> for others
```

Pin a version by appending `@<version>` or `#v<version>` (check `npm view @wenaixi/cfbridge version`).

@wenaixi/cfbridge README · Step 3: Restart & Verify：Restart DSH (`dsh --profile web`). New sessions automatically acquire `mcp__cloudflare__docs/search/execute` tools and the `cfbridge` skill.
Verify configuration with:

```powershell
dsh --profile web --dump-config | Select-String "cfbridge"
```

@wenaixi/cfbridge README · What it is：```text
DSH Bundle (Globally mounted, on-demand activation)
  └─ Installed to web profile (default), auto-mounted across all sessions
       ├─ mcp__cloudflare__docs     ← Semantic documentation search
       ├─ mcp__cloudflare__search   ← OpenAPI endpoint & schema lookup

@wenaixi/cfbridge README · What it is：- **Two-Stage Progressive Disclosure**: During `list()`, only skill index metadata (`name/description/whenToUse`, ~120–180 tokens/skill, ~1.7–2.5k tokens total) is indexed. Full skill bodies are loaded strictly on demand during `get()` (e.g., `wrangler` ~4.5k tokens), eliminating context window waste.
- **Same-Name Precedence**: The official DSH registry arbitrates same-name collisions by ascending `rank`. This bundle defaults to **`rank: 0`**, having absolute first-priority precedence over project (100/200), custom (300), user (400/500), and system (600) layers.
@wenaixi/cfbridge README · Operating Modes (`loadMode`)：cfbridge supports two operating modes, togglable via the plugin settings UI or config:

@wenaixi/cfbridge README · Operating Modes (`loadMode`)：| Mode | Value | Scope & Isolation Boundary |
|---|---|---|
| **Cloudflare Mode** (Default) | `preset` | Dynamically registers dedicated `Cloudflare 模式` agent preset and injects `CFBRIDGE_SYSTEM_INSTRUCTIONS` operational guidelines. Non-cfbridge sessions are isolated from Cloudflare tools via dual-layer defense (`tools.restrict` + `agentCtx.tools.guard`). |
| **Global Mode** | `global` | Cloudflare MCP tools and all 14 skills are globally available in all conversations. |

@wenaixi/cfbridge README · Skill Switches & UI Control：- **Operating Mode**: Toggle between Global Mode and Cloudflare Mode at the top.
- **Unified Skill Switches**: Each skill features a single unified toggle: disabled skills are completely omitted from catalog discovery for both model and user.
- **Deep Controller Architecture (`PanelController`)**:
  - Toggles are powered by an in-memory domain controller (`PanelController`).
  - **Synchronous Mutex Guard**: An in-memory synchronous lock (`_busy`) physically eliminates React asynchronous microtask race conditions, preventing revision optimism lock conflicts caused by rapid double-clicks.
  - **Clean 1-Op Atomic Batch**: Flattens skill toggles into a single atomic 1-op `form.mutate` submission (only mutating `disabledSkills`) with zero legacy baggage.
@wenaixi/cfbridge README · Configuration (`Config Schema`)：cfbridge exports a standard Schemastery Schema, customizable in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

@wenaixi/cfbridge README · Configuration (`Config Schema`)：| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `providerName` | string | `'cfbridge'` | Provider identifier (reserved name `'runtime'` is banned) |
| `skillDir` | string | Bundled path | Absolute or relative path to skills directory |
| `rank` | number | `0` | Sorting weight (lower number = higher priority; 0 is highest) |
| `cache` | boolean | `true` | Enable in-memory mtime cache for skill metadata |
| `watchSkills` | boolean | `false` | Watch skill markdown files for live HMR reload in development |
| `loadMode` | string | `'preset'` | Run mode: `'preset'` (default) or `'global'` |
| `mcpEnabled` | boolean | `true` | Enable Cloudflare MCP tools (docs / search / execute) |
| `disabledSkills` | string[] | `[]` | Fully disabled skills (both model and human toggles off) |
| `availableSkills` | string[] | `[]` | Skill catalog snapshot written back by plugin for UI display |

@wenaixi/cfbridge README · Configuration Stability & Auto-Healing：cfbridge features an integrated self-healing engine to recover corrupted or malformed configuration files:

@wenaixi/cfbridge README · Configuration Stability & Auto-Healing：- **Two-Stage Resilient Parser**: Recovers active settings from truncated YAML (e.g. power-cut interruptions) and syntax-shattered files via heuristic line-scanning.
- **Automatic Backup**: Forces a timestamped `.bak.<timestamp>` backup before modifying files on disk.
- **Clean Regeneration**: Regenerates compliant 2-line patch YAML retaining secure dynamic `!!js` token templates.
- **One-Click CLI Tool**:
  ```powershell
  node scripts/repair-config.js                       # Diagnose & heal root cordis.patch.yml
  node scripts/repair-config.js --file <path>         # Heal specified config file
  node scripts/repair-config.js --profile web         # Heal web profile configuration
  node scripts/repair-config.js --dry-run             # Dry-run inspection without modifying files

@wenaixi/cfbridge README · Default Workflow: search -> execute：Always adhere to the "search before execute" principle:

```javascript
// 1. Search: Look up Worker script endpoints from OpenAPI schema
async () => Object.entries(spec.paths)
  .filter(([path, item]) => path.includes('workers/scripts') && item.get)
  .slice(0, 10)
